flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction fired on Jedi-Test-completed event (front getGameTextRequiredAfterTriggers); event trigger, not table-changed polling
flipToBack.prose: Flip when Jedi Test #5 is completed by Luke (or by Leia if the Daughter Of Skywalker retarget game-text modification is active) and the objective can be flipped.

children.req: timing trigger: Jedi Test #5 completed by apprentice

flipToFront.prose: Back never flips to front. Instead it is PLACED OUT OF PLAY (and the apprentice's Jedi Tests canceled) if you initiate a Force drain at a Dagobah location or the apprentice (Luke/Leia) is placed out of play.

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back is a pure timing trigger (Jedi Test completion event); no control/occupy/presence board check on either flip direction.

Apprentice identity is chosen-state: ModifyGameTextType.MIND_WHAT_YOU_HAVE_LEARNED_SAVE_YOU_IT_CAN__TARGETS_LEIA_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE is set for remainder of game when Daughter Of Skywalker is deployed via the objective's download (Card7_138.java:113-117).

Back hard-lose leaf 1 = timing trigger: TriggerConditions.forceDrainInitiatedBy(game, effectResult, playerId, Filters.Dagobah_location) - YOUR OWN drain at a Dagobah location (Card7_138_BACK.java:80).
Back hard-lose leaf 2 = timing trigger: TriggerConditions.justPlacedOutOfPlayFromTable(game, effectResult, <Luke|Leia>) (Card7_138_BACK.java:81).
Back take-into-hand action requires apprentice at a location you CONTROL: Filters.at(Filters.controls(playerId)) (Card7_138_BACK.java:101).
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy Dagobah system from Reserve Deck (Filters.Dagobah_system) (Card7_138.java:64-74); after deployment completes, Dagobah system may not be converted for rest of game (MayNotBeConvertedModifier) (Card7_138.java:77-83).

Front deploy-phase download (GameTextActionId.MIND_WHAT_YOUR_HAVE_LEARNED__DOWNLOAD_CARD_TO_DAGOBAH, any number of times while available): deploy Luke, Daughter Of Skywalker, Yoda (Yoda deploys -2 via cost arg on Filters.Yoda), Yoda's Hope, At Peace, or Luke's Backpack to Dagobah system from Reserve Deck, ignoring location deployment restrictions; reshuffle (Card7_138.java:86-125; Luke-variant filter :111, Leia-variant filter :101).
Deploying Daughter Of Skywalker via this route retargets the whole objective to Leia for remainder of game (ModifyGameTextModifier) (Card7_138.java:113-117).
otherObligations: Front: whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one (ModifierFlag.DRAW_TWO_AND_CHOOSE_ONE_FOR_TRAINING_DESTINY) (Card7_138.java:133).
Front: apprentice's completed Jedi Tests are placed on table (PlaceJediTestOnTableWhenCompletedModifier) (Card7_138.java:136-137); Jedi Test #5 stack-destiny-card game text enabled (:134-135).
Front: you may not Force drain at Dagobah locations (Card7_138.java:138); your cards at Dagobah may not contribute to Force retrieval (:139-140).
Front: +4 to each player's destiny draws for Sense and Alter (Card7_138.java:141).
Back: on flip, immediately retrieve 10 Force (Card7_138_BACK.java:66-76).

Back: once per move phase (or deploy phase with SAVE_YOU_IT_CAN__MOVE_PHASE_MAY_BE_TREATED_AS_DEPLOY_PHASE mod), use 3 Force to take apprentice into hand from a location you control; cards on him go to Used Pile (Card7_138_BACK.java:99-144).

Back: apprentice's Jedi Tests suspended (not lost) while apprentice off table (Card7_138_BACK.java:154-155); apprentice ignores location deployment restrictions (:156-157); opponent may not play Sense or Alter (:158).

Back HARD LOSE: placed out of play and apprentice's Jedi Tests canceled if you Force drain at a Dagobah location or apprentice placed out of play (Card7_138_BACK.java:79-93). After flip, NEVER Force drain at Dagobah.

profileGaps: flipGateCardIds empty: the true flip gate is completion of Jedi Test #5 (Filters.Jedi_Test_5 -> 4_78/225_48); the Jedi-Test-completion gate is not encoded anywhere in the profile
keyCharacterFilter null: the flip actor is the apprentice (Filters.Luke, or Filters.Leia under Daughter Of Skywalker retarget) - not covered
pullableCards empty: front deploy-phase download suite (Luke/Daughter Of Skywalker/Yoda[-2]/Yoda's Hope/At Peace/Luke's Backpack to Dagobah) not represented
requiredCardsOnTable empty: Jedi Test #5 must reach table/completion; only Dagobah locations appear in objectiveNamedLocations
back hard-lose triggers (you Force drain at Dagobah; apprentice placed out of play) not represented
